# Customer CRM Requirements Checklist: Phase 11 Reporting & Access Control

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality gate for the owner-approved, clinic-scoped operational store-customer CRM.
**Created**: 2026-09-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` workflow from the owner-approved CRM change control.
**Review Ownership**: Mark an item `[x]` only when the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied; it does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the CRM purpose, explicit operational-only boundary, and prohibited marketing/clinical-profiling uses defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023, §FR-033]
- [x] CHK002 Are the canonical population, display-name route, allowed commerce inputs, and prohibited response data exhaustively specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023, §FR-028, Contract `customer-crm-api.md`]
- [x] CHK003 Are the ADMIN/session/clinic-access conditions and no-disclosure denial population specified for every CRM request? [Security, Spec §FR-027, Contract `authorization-matrix.md`]
- [x] CHK004 Are CRM audit provenance, per-disclosed-patient behavior, metadata minimization, and audit-failure behavior specified? [Auditability, Spec §FR-031, Contract `customer-crm-api.md`]

## Requirement Clarity and Consistency

- [x] CHK005 Are the segment boundaries stated as exhaustive and non-overlapping with no implied order-count substitution? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK006 Are monetary, product-frequency, last-purchase, filtered-summary, rounding, and zero-denominator formulas unambiguous and consistent with operational revenue? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005–006, §FR-029–030]
- [x] CHK007 Are pagination/search/filter/sort/default/tie-break rules and invalid versus unauthorized clinic behavior explicitly distinguishable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027, §FR-030, Contract `customer-crm-api.md`]
- [x] CHK008 Are the CRM authorization and data-minimization rules consistent across the spec, data model, authorization matrix, conditional exclusions, contract, quickstart, plan, and task mapping? [Consistency, Spec §Roadmap Traceability]

## Acceptance Criteria and Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK009 Can the required 0/1/2/4/5 segment cases, payment/refund arithmetic, empty population, query validation, and filtered pagination be measured from canonical source rows? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008–009, Quickstart §Required validation scenarios]
- [x] CHK010 Are permitted ADMIN, PATIENT/DOCTOR/STAFF denial, disabled/revoked/expired session denial, and active foreign-clinic denial all required at backend and browser boundaries? [Coverage, Spec §SC-010, Contract `authorization-matrix.md`]
- [x] CHK011 Are real-source dashboard loading, error, empty, populated, responsive, and pagination requirements clear without mock data or inert controls? [Coverage, Spec §FR-032]

## Boundaries and Dependencies

- [x] CHK012 Are new CRM persistence, migration, aggregate infrastructure, export, saved segment, audience, campaign, bulk messaging, marketing, retention/copy table, and unrelated marketing-page changes expressly excluded? [Boundary, Spec §FR-033, Contract `conditional-exclusions.md`]
- [x] CHK013 Is the pre-existing `ClinicalClinicAccess` release prerequisite documented without granting this task authority to add a membership or invitation system? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Quickstart §Preconditions]
- [x] CHK014 Are the serialized T07/T09 dependencies, OpenAPI/client and Vitest single-writer ownership, disposable PostgreSQL verification, and separate Playwright retention all specified? [Traceability, Plan §Serialized Batches, Tasks §Single-Writer and Parallel Rules]

## Notes

- Leave an item unchecked when the requirement is incomplete, ambiguous, inconsistent, unmeasurable, or lacks traceability.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state but must not modify markers.
